title: extract-results output
description: Every quantitative result the paper reports, one row per (method, dataset, metric, setting) number, each cited to the result passage, table or chart it comes from.

method.description: The system, model or baseline as the paper names it.

dataset.description: The dataset, benchmark or split (e.g. 'WMT 2014 English-German').

value.description: The reported number only: no unit, no ± spread, no footnote mark.

unit.description: '%', 'FLOPs', 'ms', … or null for a unitless score.

is_proposed.description: True for the paper's own method (or a variant of it).

setting.description: What distinguishes this number from a sibling: model size, ablation, shots, ± spread.
